model.architecture: decoder-only, SwiGLU, mlp_ratio 8, RoPE, RMSNorm with affine eps 1e-6, no biases, untied embeddings, init normal std 0.02 truncated at 3 std

decontamination.rule: two passes before tokenization (scripts/decontaminate.py): (1) exact: remove a training document whose SHA-256 of NFC-normalized text equals a sha256_nfc in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl; (2) 13-gram: remove a remaining training document that shares at least one 13-gram with any evaluation document, over text normalized by NFC, casefolding and replacing every non-letter, non-digit character with a space, then split on whitespace; 13-grams are matched by 64-bit blake2b hash against replication_protocol/eval_13grams.npz. Per corpus, the report gives the documents removed by each pass and the evaluation ids each pass hit

per_document_logging.evaluator: asla-c4_en-complete (complete_eval=True: fixed order, no shuffling, nothing dropped, padding masked)

eval.definition: c4_en_bits_per_token: summed next-token cross-entropy (nats) over every token of the 2,099 evaluation documents, each predicted exactly once by the complete deterministic evaluator (windows of 2048, stride 2047, over [EOS] + file), divided by the token count (1,021,899) and by ln 2, at the final checkpoint; computed from the per-document logs by scripts/rescore_replication.py build. OLMo's own reported metric is not used.
eval.file: DataDecide's in-loop c4_en-validation file: OLMo eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy (https://olmo-data.org/eval-data/perplexity/v3_small_gptneox20b/c4_en/val/part-0-00000.npy, sha256 c37d6b115de9120bfaefe9ca6a20a310eb6738c20bc26abf469dcada66100ab4) with its part-0-00000.csv.gz metadata; 2,099 documents, 1,021,899 tokens, listed by id and text hash in replication_protocol/eval_set.jsonl
